newsitem.title: USA: Lamar Advertising to buy Penn Ad for cash.
newsitem.headline: Lamar Advertising to buy Penn Ad for cash.

text.p: Lamar Advertising Co said Monday it had a definitive agreement to buy Penn Advertising Inc for about $167 million cash.
Lamar, an outdoor advertising company, said the acquisition gives it about 8,429 displays located in the eastern and northeastern United States.
Penn Advertising is majority-owned by an institutional fund managed by an affiliate of Trust Co of the West, a Los Angeles asset management company, Lamar said.
Penn Ad shareholders will use about $50 million of the sale proceeds to repay outstanding company debt.
